comment: With a menu open, the pointer moving onto another title opens that title's menu in its place. Krita behaves this way, where Filter stayed open under the pointer on Tools. The open menu is a focused embedded window, so the bar listens at the root window's input. The dump's open_menus names what is open after each move.
01, the pointer on a title with no menu open: nothing opens.
02, Filter open, the pointer well away from the bar.
03, the pointer moved onto Tools: Tools is open in Filter's place, with no press.
04, the pointer back on the bar's own empty stretch, off every title: Tools stays open.
05, on Edit, and then on Edit again: Edit is open, and the pointer still on its title is not the close a press on it would be.
06, escape closed the menu, and the pointer still on the title of the menu that closed opens nothing.
07, 1280 by 1024 at scale 2, where the last title holds Filter, Modules and Help: File open, and the pointer onto the last title opens its list in File's place.
08, the pointer back onto File: the list closes and File opens.
